Fitting Room row icons

These PNGs are rasterised from game-icons.net SVGs, licensed CC BY 3.0.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

The background rect each source SVG ships was removed so the shape sits on
transparency; the editor tints it per row. No other change was made.

  arrows.png  delapouite/quiver                Delapouite
  battleaxe.png delapouite/warhammer             Delapouite
  bolts.png   delapouite/dart                  Delapouite
  bow.png     delapouite/bow-arrow             Delapouite
  crossbow.png carl-olsen/crossbow              Carl Olsen
  dagger.png  lorc/plain-dagger                Lorc
  greatsword.png lorc/relic-blade                 Lorc
  mace.png    delapouite/flanged-mace          Delapouite
  staff.png   lorc/wizard-staff                Lorc
  sword.png   lorc/broadsword                  Lorc
  waraxe.png  delapouite/war-axe               Delapouite

The armour rows below come from the same source and the same pipeline. Font
Awesome 5 Free Solid has no leg, hip, waist, trousers or shoulder glyph at
all, which was established by enumerating the bundled font rather than by
reading a cheatsheet, so these five rows could not be fixed with a codepoint.

  leg.png     delapouite/armor-cuisses         Delapouite
  pelvis.png  delapouite/belt-armor            Delapouite
  shoulder.png skoll/pauldrons                 Skoll

Three pictures for five rows. Both legs share leg.png and both pelvis rows
share pelvis.png, which is this table's own convention: Face and Face (alt)
are one glyph, and so are Arm (left) and Arm (right). The row label is what
separates outer from under.

hair.png comes from Material Symbols instead, licensed Apache 2.0.
https://github.com/google/material-design-icons

  hair.png    symbols/web/face_3 (filled)      Google

A second source for one icon, because neither Font Awesome set has a hair
glyph and game-icons has exactly one in 4,239, which is unreadable at row
size. The body row needed no asset at all: Font Awesome has a feminine
figure and it is drawn as a glyph.

The icon FONT the editor draws its glyphs from, icons.ttf beside this file, is
Font Awesome Free, licensed SIL OFL 1.1.
https://fontawesome.com/  https://scripts.sil.org/OFL

  icons.ttf   Font Awesome Free (webfont)      Fonticons, Inc.

robe.png is the Menu Studio action bar tile rather than a row, and it comes
from the same game-icons.net set and the same pipeline as the rows above.

  robe.png    lorc/robe                        Lorc

It replaced hood.png, which was original to this project and drawn by a
script in tools. Nothing here is drawn in-house any more, so there is no
longer a second attribution rule to keep apart from the one at the top.
